item.title: Tim Cook - Wikipedia
item.description: Timothy Donald Cook (born November 1, 1960) is an American business executive who served as the chief executive officer (CEO) of Apple from August 24, 2011, to August 31, 2026, and has been the company's executive chairman since September 1, 2026. [1]

item.title: John Ternus - Wikipedia
item.description: John Patrick Ternus (/ ˈtɜːrnəs /; born May 1975) is an American engineer and business executive who has been the chief executive officer (CEO) of Apple since September 1, 2026.

item.title: Tim Cook to become Apple Executive Chairman John Ternus to become Apple CEO
item.description: Apple announced Tim Cook will become executive chairman of Apple’s board of directors and John Ternus will become Apple’s next CEO.

item.title: Apple Leadership - Tim Cook - Apple
item.description: Tim Cook has been a director since 2011 and serves as the executive chair of the board. He joined Apple in 1998 and served as the company’s CEO from 2011 to 2026. Apple was named the World’s Most Admired Company by Fortune during every year of Tim’s CEO tenure.
